sn2.4:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Māgadho devaputto Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn2.4:2.1: Kati lokasmiṃ pajjotā || yehi loko pakāsati || bhavantaṃ puṭṭhum āgamma || kathaṃ janemu taṃ mayan ti || ||
sn2.4:3.1: Cattāro loke pajjotā || pañcam-ettha na vajjati || divā tapati ādicco || rattim ābhāti candimā ||
sn2.4:4.1: atha aggi divārattiṃ || tattha tattha pakāsati || sambuddho tapataṃ seṭṭho || esā ābhā anuttarā ti || ||
